This is to inform you that a meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company will be held at the Registered Office on Thursday and Friday, January 9th and 10th, 2020 to consider inter alia;1. The audited consolidated financial results of the Company and its subsidiaries as per Indian Accounting Standards (IndAS) for the quarter and nine months ending December 31, 2019;2.
